order: 1 obtain open event neighborhood W in ambient reduced Y
2 construct C2 T:W->R and R_Y:W->Y through the full-X bridge
3 impose initial section-chart domain D_in=j^{-1}(W intersect Sigma_loc)
4 impose terminal domain D=D_in intersect (R_Y o j)^{-1}(Sigma_loc)
6 choose lambda_* in (0,1] so B_{lambda_*} subset D

exact_center_event_window.center_speed_statement: partial_t g_Y(Psi_t(Y_*)) is at least the registered center uniform speed for every t in I; this equals the lifted full-X event speed
exact_center_event_window.center_uniqueness: strict positive speed makes 2P the unique zero in I
exact_center_event_window.declared_ball_semantics: the ambient Y-norm ball centered at the exact section point Y_*; intermediate orbit histories need not satisfy g_Y=0

exact_inputs.equation_class: a finite-dimensional autonomous RFDE with the two fixed physical delays 4*sqrt(5) and 5*sqrt(5)
exact_inputs.event_domain_and_regularity: g_Y:Y->R and g_X:X->R are affine C-infinity
exact_inputs.initial_coordinate_injection: j(x_s,x_u)=Y_*+x_s+q_hat*x_u, with x_s in ker(f_hat), ||q_hat||_Y=1, and the fixed Stage-3/4N Route-C splitting
exact_inputs.regularity: the full-X leaky FHN history functional is polynomial in current and delayed evaluations, hence C-infinity
exact_inputs.stable_history_quantifier: every continuous x_s in ker(f_hat) satisfying the norm bound; no finite-node replacement
exact_inputs.validated_periodic_center: the exact phase-fixed full RFDE orbit X_*^X and its reduced projection Y_*=pi(X_*^X)

physical_normalization.norm: the inherited max history norm Y, not a period-normalized norm
physical_normalization.state: physical voltage history and physical recovery current
physical_normalization.time: all T, P, h, and delays are physical times

proof_mechanism.step_1_full_X_to_reduced_Y_bridge: apply Stage-4R to Phi on X with Iota:W->X, then compose with the exact affine lift Iota and bounded projection pi to obtain joint C2 smoothing in Y
proof_mechanism.step_2_center_geometry: the true P interval puts 2P strictly inside the fixed I
proof_mechanism.step_3_center_tube: the global physical orbit-history speed times the largest phase offset is smaller than the declared section-ball radius
proof_mechanism.step_4_center_sign_and_speed: the Stage-2 uniform physical voltage speed integrates over at least h at both endpoints, giving the two strict signs
proof_mechanism.step_5_event_neighborhood_W: joint continuous dependence and openness of the maximal semiflow domain, uniformly over compact I, preserve half of the center endpoint and speed margins on one ambient Y-neighborhood W of Y_*
proof_mechanism.step_6_initial_and_terminal_domains: apply the Stage-4R selected-event theorem on W to construct C2 maps T and R_Y, intersect j^{-1}(W) first with the initial Sigma_loc chart domain and then with the inverse image of Sigma_loc under R_Y o j; the resulting D is open and contains 0
proof_mechanism.step_7_choose_lambda_last: only after D is fixed, use ||x_s+q_hat*x_u||_Y<=lambda*(0.0097+0.00025) to choose lambda_*>0 with the complete arbitrary-continuous-history B_{lambda_*} subset D

qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.ambient_strengthening: the event theorem first holds on W in the ambient reduced space Y; the local-section coordinate ball is imposed later
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.common_solution_domain: (t,Iota(y)) belongs to the full-X maximal RFDE semiflow domain for every (t,y) in I x W
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.event_open_neighborhood_W: there is an open W subset Y containing Y_* on which the common-window full-lift solution domain, two endpoint signs, and uniform positive speed all hold
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.final_coordinate_domain: after imposing both initial and terminal section-patch gates, D is an open neighborhood of 0 in E_s x R
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.full_ball_scope: lambda_* is chosen last so B_{lambda_*} subset D; the conclusion then holds simultaneously for every member, including arbitrary continuous stable histories
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.regularity_output: T:W->R and R_Y(y)=Psi_{T(y)}(y):W->Y are C2 by the proved full-X/reduced-Y bridge
qualitative_scaled_full_ball_theorem.selected_event_output: for every y in W there is exactly one T(y) in the fixed I with g_Y(Psi_{T(y)}(y))=0 and positive orientation

reduced_history_bridge.Stage4R_full_space_input: Stage-4R is applied only to Phi on X, with initial parameterization Iota:W subset Y->X and full event g_X=g_Y o pi; the section injection j is imposed later
reduced_history_bridge.compatible_range_after_memory: Phi_t=Iota o Psi_t o pi for every t>=r
reduced_history_bridge.event_intertwining: g_X(Phi_t(Iota(y)))=g_Y(Psi_t(y)); endpoint signs, speed, and the selected time are identical in X and Y
reduced_history_bridge.intertwining: pi o Phi_t=Psi_t o pi for every t>=0
reduced_history_bridge.lift_regularity: Iota is affine C-infinity, DIota is the proved continuous linear split right inverse of pi, and pi o Iota=Id_Y
reduced_history_bridge.periodic_center_compatibility: the full periodic center satisfies X_*^X=Iota(Y_*) because its recovery history solves the recovery ODE on every length-r orbit segment
reduced_history_bridge.reduced_C2_corollary: on t>2r, (t,y)->Psi_t(y)=pi(Phi_t(Iota(y))) is jointly C2 because pi is bounded linear, Iota is affine C-infinity, and the Stage-4R full-X segment map is jointly C2
reduced_history_bridge.reduced_semiflow: Psi_t=pi o Phi_t o Iota for every t>=0

return_domain_containment.final_domain: D=D_in intersect R_j^{-1}(Sigma_loc), open in E_s x R and containing 0
return_domain_containment.induced_return: P_sel=chi o R_j:D->D_out is an induced C2 selected section return; no assertion P_sel(D) subset D is made
return_domain_containment.initial_section_domain: D_in=j^{-1}(W intersect Sigma_loc), open in E_s x R and containing 0
return_domain_containment.terminal_chart: chi(y)=(P_s(y-Y_*),f_hat(y-Y_*)):Sigma_loc->D_out is affine C-infinity and has inverse j restricted to D_out
return_domain_containment.terminal_chart_codomain: D_out=chi(Sigma_loc), an open subset of E_s x R
return_domain_containment.why_local_patch: R_Y(Y_*)=Y_* and continuity of R_Y make R_j^{-1}(Sigma_loc) open relative to its event section domain
